summary: Enhance your knowledge with our Data Privacy and Protection Compliance Training Course. Master GDPR and CCPA regulations to safeguard your organization.
lede: GDPR-focused data privacy training helps professionals who handle personal data apply privacy principles in their day-to-day work. It covers mapping personal data and assessing privacy risks, managing lawful processing and consent, and responding to data subject requests and breaches, while showing how to build privacy into processes and communicate responsibilities across an organization.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals involved in managing, processing, or safeguarding personal data across various sectors.
modules: Understanding Data Privacy and Global Compliance
Principles of Data Protection (GDPR & CCPA Core Concepts)
Data Breach Management and Incident Response
The Role of the Data Protection Officer (DPO)
Building and Sustaining a Privacy Culture
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of data handling and protection concepts. Familiarity with organizational compliance processes is beneficial but not mandatory.
